left.raw_text: Patient must be 18 years or older
Must meet the following definition for adhesive capsulitis

right.raw_text: as defined by the American Academy of Orthopedic Surgeons: Self-limiting condition resulting from any inflammatory process about the shoulder in which capsular scar tissue is produced, resulting in pain and limited range of motion; also called frozen shoulder
Non-query-able: Self-limiting condition resulting from any inflammatory process about the shoulder in which capsular scar tissue is produced, resulting in pain and limited range of motion; also called frozen shoulder

right.raw_text: Must be amenable to randomization into either cohort
Post-eligibility: Must be amenable to randomization into either cohort
